segments.t: Run north to Razor Hill. On the speedrun, move on once the local quests turn green; lower-level kills give less xp than in Classic.

tips.text: Run north to Razor Hill. On the way, kill Durotar Tigers for Practical Prey when you see them.

segments.t: Sit at Brakk's campfire until the rest buff lands, then turn the quest in.

tips.text: Campfire buffs (Fish Bowl +8% stats at Fishing 20, and other players' camp items) are optional. The route works with none of them. A Camp Tent only fills rested xp up to 5% of a level and does nothing if you already have more.
Cooking a basic meal gives Well Fed: +5% kill xp for 15 minutes, if you keep food on hand. The route does not require it.
Warchief's Blessing is shouted at the Razor Hill guard tower (+300 health, 15% haste, not an xp buff; it drops on death). Optional.

Troll priests: lesser-heal Grunt Kor'ja, buff her with Fortitude, and return to Tai'jin.
Turn in Legging It to Gar'Thok

segments.t: Complete Vanquish the Betrayers. On the keep outskirts, take the Raider's Bow, Raider's Battleaxe, and Raider's Shield.

tips.text: Tiragarde Keep: clear the sailors outside first, then work up the keep for the marines. Lieutenant Benedict is on the top floor. Loot the key he drops: it opens his chest, which starts The Admiral's Orders.
The marines come in pairs. Fight with your back to a wall so they cannot surround you.
Pull the sailors one at a time; skip marines you do not need.
Benedict has a guard by him. Kill the guard first, then Benedict.
